name: The Floating Island of Upward Waterfalls
description: A cluster of lush, green floating islands in the sky, with streams of water cascading upwards into the clouds, creating a beautiful, gravity-defying spectacle.
prompt: A breathtaking view of a cluster of lush, green floating islands suspended in the sky. Streams of water from the lakes on the islands flow upwards, defying gravity, cascading into the soft, white clouds above. Rainbows form in the mist of the upward waterfalls. The islands are covered in green vegetation and wildflowers. Epic, surreal, fantasy landscape.
caption: Where the water flows to the heavens, and islands drift in a silent, endless dance of gravity. 💧🌈
